changelog:
- Initial release of cinematic-story-video-gen for generating cinematic story videos.
- Supports text-to-video and image-to-video with cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, widescreen framing, and narrative camera moves.
- Includes model selection: KLING_V3_0_PRO (default), KLING_V3_0_STA, and SEEDANCE_2_0 (draft/fast tier).
- Requires WERYAI_API_KEY and Node.js 18+; explicitly confirms parameters and prompt with user before submitting paid tasks.
- Adds a mandatory pre-submit approval workflow and detailed CLI/API references for video generation commands.
